free_tier.stated: No free plan on Plausible Cloud: every account starts with a free 30-day trial with Business plan features and limits and no credit card; the cheapest plan after it is Starter at EUR 9/month for up to 10k monthly pageviews and one site
free_tier.notes: The trial does not convert to a paid subscription by itself, because no payment method is on file. Growth is EUR 14/month and Business, the plan with the Stats API, EUR 19/month, at the same 10k pageview tier.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: billed by pageviews and custom events, not stored objects

retention.stated: When an unsubscribed trial ends, the dashboard is locked, new stats are no longer collected, and dashboards and stats are eventually deleted after an e-mail warning; paid plans state no retention limit

egress.terms: not applicable: a hosted dashboard; stats leave through the Stats API at 600 requests per hour per key, a Business plan feature that the trial includes

interface_detail: Stats API: a read-only HTTP interface, POST /api/v2/query with an API key in the Authorization header, 600 requests per hour by default; on the Business plan and during the trial. The Sites API is Enterprise-only.
tooling: the tracking script on the site, and any HTTP client with a Stats API key
chaining: A 30-day window to evaluate privacy-focused web analytics, then EUR 9 a month; there is no free allowance to build on.

limits.value: 30-day trial, then the dashboard is locked and new stats are not collected
600 Stats API requests per hour per key
Starter: up to 10k monthly pageviews, one site

binding_note: The trial ends after 30 days and the dashboard locks, before any pageview or API limit matters.

identity_cost.detail: The registration form asks for a full name, an e-mail address and a password of at least 12 characters, behind a Friendly Captcha check; no credit card is asked for.

reliability_note: After an unsubscribed trial, collection stops and dashboards and stats are deleted permanently after an e-mail warning.
confidence_note: The trial terms, plan prices and API limits are quoted from first-party pages. No account was opened.
